messages:
anna: Quick weekly check-in for Quantacore (Private/VPC). Focus: region-by-region health, KMS/HSM, spend. TL;DR: us-west-2 mostly green, eu-central has KMS rotation flakiness, ap-southeast saw intermittent peering latency spikes last night. Spend +18% MoM driven by nightly batch jobs. Renewal currently low risk but we need a runbook walk + SSO enablement to keep it that way.

mike_ops: Posting region summary from the console metrics: 
- us-west-2: uptime 99.99%, p50 38ms, p95 210ms, 502 rate 0.12% -> stable
- eu-central-1: uptime 99.7%, p50 45ms, p95 540ms, KMS timeouts 0.9% last 24h, 504 spikes during key rotations
- ap-southeast-1: uptime 99.5%, p50 60ms, p95 880ms, transient connectivity blips ~03:30-04:15 UTC likely peering/BGP flaps
- spend: projected weekly $12.4k (up from $10.5k) — batch jobs + increased token usage on reranks

tariq: Noted the eu KMS rotation failures. I pulled the logs, looks like our rotation job got rate-limited by the customer's KMS for ~6 mins. Suggest temporary retry/backoff and short-window fallback to cached DEKs for reads. Will open an ops ticket.

infra-bot: ALERT: kms-rotation-failure eu-central-1 at 2026-03-18T03:12:48Z triggered 3 retries, error: KMS.ThrottlingException, request-id: abcd-1234

julia_cs: Customer feedback: Quantacore reported that when the KMS flaked their app showed "token expired" errors which caused a support ticket. They asked for a simple runbook and a contact during rotations. Also asked for a cost breakdown per environment (staging vs prod). I sent the cost CSV this morning.

mike_ops: Plan for this week: 
1) Deploy retry/backoff to rotation job (tariq)
2) Add short-lived cached DEK fallback for reads (tariq + kevin)
3) Alert on KMS.ThrottlingException with customer-facing blurb enabled (me)
4) Runbook + scheduled walkthrough with Quantacore (julia to schedule)

kevin_sre: I'll own the cached DEK fallback and will add a canary flag. Also want to run a failover test to our secondary KMS region (us-west-2) in staging before we touch prod. If rotation errors continue after retries, I'd mark this as medium renewal risk until runbook + scheduled maintenance window is in place.

anna: Thanks, all. Action items: tariq open ops ticket and link runbook draft -> ticket 4582, kevin create canary branch PR by EOD Thu, julia schedule customer walkthrough for next Tue, mike enable alert with one-click customer blurb. I'll ping sales about the spend uptick so they can surface it in renewal conversation. :thumbsup:

kevin_sre: Quick snippet I'll add to the runbook for engineers to test KMS fallback locally:
```bash
# simulate KMS throttling fallback test
export REDWOOD_ENV=staging
python tests/kms_fallback_test.py --region eu-central-1 --simulate-throttle
```

tariq: Ticket 4582 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4582. Added logs, sample request-ids, and recommended rollback steps. Assigned to @tariq and @kevin_sre.

julia_cs: I'll attach the customer-facing blurb and schedule the walkthrough. Also capturing feedback: they want clearer docs for SSO + onboarding checklist — adding to next week's enablement sync.

anna: Perfect. I'll follow up with a short email summary to Quantacore and loop in security for the KMS plan. Anything else?

mike_ops: One more note — ap-southeast peering provider says they saw a micro-outage at 03:40 UTC affecting ~8 mins. We'll correlate traceroutes from the VPC connectors and report back.

kevin_sre: Aiming to have the PR and a staging run by Friday. If we hit blockers I'll escalate.

anna: Great. Closing this thread — will re-open next weekly check or sooner if CS-4582 escalates. :calendar:
